prop.mcp_toolset.endpoint.hint: Choose an endpoint configured in the MCP Toolset settings page
prop.mcp_toolset.expose_tools.hint: Register this endpoint's tools as callable tools for the model
prop.mcp_toolset.tools_selected_only.hin: Expose only the tools explicitly checked on the settings page (probe the endpoint once to sync the list)
prop.mcp_toolset.resource_injection.hint: Whether to read this endpoint's resources into the context, overriding the endpoint setting
prop.mcp_toolset.expose_resource_tool.hi: Add a tool that lets the model list and read this endpoint's resources on demand
prop.mcp_toolset.inject_instructions.hin: Write the server's self-reported usage instructions into the context
prop.mcp_toolset.failure_policy.hint: When connecting or enumerating fails, abort this round or skip the endpoint and continue
prop.markdown.pipe_tables.hint: Enable GFM pipe tables (| a | b |)
prop.markdown.enable_math.hint: Render $...$, $$...$$, \(...\) and \[...\] as formulas (KStyleMath, a pure C# port of KaTeX). Code blocks and \$ are unaffected.
prop.markdown.math_output.hint: MathML: MathML only, rendered natively by the browser, no extra stylesheet needed. KatexHtml: KaTeX-compatible HTML + MathML (accessibility copy + visual copy); katex.min.css must be loaded first, otherwise each formula is shown twice and the layout breaks. Enable it by adding @import url("/katex/katex.min.css"); to the theme's custom CSS.
prop.code_highlight.skip_languages.hint: Comma-separated, case-insensitive. Matching code blocks are left as-is for later nodes to handle (default svg,mermaid)
prop.code_highlight.max_chars.hint: Code blocks longer than this are not highlighted; 0 = no limit
prop.code_highlight.match_timeout.hint: Upper bound for a single regex match; when exceeded, that block falls back to plain text. 0 = disabled. AI output is untrusted input, so keeping a limit is recommended
prop.code_highlight.default_language.hin: Language used for code blocks without an info string; empty = no highlighting
prop.code_actions.show_language.hint: Shows the code block language on the left of the toolbar
prop.code_actions.show_copy.hint: Copies the plain text of the code block
prop.code_actions.show_download.hint: Downloads the code block as a file; the extension is inferred from the language (unknown = .txt)
prop.svg_render.show_download.hint: Downloads the SVG as a .svg file; adds the namespace and a UTF-8 declaration so it opens standalone
prop.svg_render.max_chars.hint: Code blocks longer than this are not parsed as SVG; 0 = no limit
prop.comment.text.hint: Arbitrary text for documentation only, does not affect generation
prop.call_node.preset_id.hint: ID of the generation preset to inline
prop.dyn_prompt.set_name.hint: Name of the DynPromptSet to use. Leave empty to use all sets
prop.dyn_prompt.role.hint: Used by At depth mode only; Injection slot mode uses the role chosen on the injection slot node
prop.dyn_prompt_slot.role.hint: Role used by injected content (system / user / assistant); DynPrompt's Injection slot mode keeps this role. tool_result is not supported because an injection slot has no tool call id.
prop.fragment.content.hint: The text content to inject into the context
prop.fragment_trim.token_budget.hint: Max tokens before trimming from head
prop.fragment_trim.count.hint: Messages to keep in LatestN mode
prop.if_node.source.hint: Where to read the left-hand value from
prop.if_node.value.hint: Right-hand value. Numeric or string, auto-detected.
prop.if_node.on_convert_fail.hint: Behavior when source returns null or empty
prop.adv_if.condition.hint: C# boolean expression. Globals: Fragments (List<ContextSegment>), SharedState (Dictionary<string,object>), KVData (IKVDataService). Preset usings: System.Linq, SharperLLM.Util, System.Collections.Generic.
prop.memory_retrieve.recent_messages.hin: Number of recent messages used for memory search
prop.merge_fragments.target_role.hint: Role assigned to the merged fragment
prop.message_print_v2.ignore_null_proper: Skip properties whose value is null or empty
prop.message_print_v2.colorize_tool_args: Apply JSON syntax coloring to tool call arguments
prop.sequence.repeat.hint: Number of times to repeat the sequence
prop.sub_agent.output_mode.hint: LastMessage, FullJson, or None. Overrides config if set
prop.sub_agent.shared_guid.hint: When enabled, the sub-agent inherits the parent AgentGuid. When disabled, uses the config GUID as an independent identity.
prop.sub_agent_tool.shared_agent_guid.hi: When enabled (default), the sub-agent inherits the parent AgentGuid. When disabled, uses the config GUID as an independent identity — same meaning as 'Shared GUID' on the SubAgent node.
prop.sub_agent_tool.shared_chat_guid.hin: When enabled (default), the sub-agent inherits the parent chat Guid. When disabled, each session gets its own Chat scope, so chat-scoped state (variables, memory) is per session.
prop.tool_preset.preset_id.hint: Leave empty to use the default preset, or enter a preset ID to match
prop.fs_tool_set.enable_overview.hint: Enable the file system overview tool
prop.fs_tool_set.allow_list.hint: One regex pattern per line. If empty, all paths are allowed.
prop.fs_tool_set.ban_list.hint: One regex pattern per line. BanList takes precedence over AllowList.
prop.fs_tool_set.scope_mode.hint: How to merge with the global FileSystem config
prop.web_search.provider.hint: Which web search service to use. 'From settings' follows the default service configured in the Web Search panel
prop.web_search_auto.query_source.hint: Last user message: use the current input; Fixed text: use the fixed query below
prop.web_search_auto.static_query.hint: Used when the query source is 'Fixed text'
prop.web_search_auto.rewrite.hint: Ask the current API to turn the input into a search query. Costs one extra model call and requires an API select node earlier in the tree
prop.web_search_auto.rewrite_prompt.hint: Must contain the {input} placeholder that receives the raw input
prop.web_search_auto.max_query_chars.hin: Maximum query characters (cut at a word boundary). 0 disables truncation. Some services limit query length, e.g. DeepSeek allows 128
prop.web_search_auto.max_results.hint: Number of results for this search. 0 uses the default from the settings panel
prop.web_search_auto.role.hint: Role of the injected fragment (system / user / assistant)
prop.web_search_auto.header.hint: Text placed before the result block. Leave empty to inject the results only
prop.web_search_auto.on_failure.hint: What to do when no query can be derived or the search fails: fail the generation, or log and skip this injection
prop.web_search_tool_set.enable_search.h: Adds the web_search tool so the model decides when to search
prop.web_search_tool_set.enable_fetch.hi: Adds the web_fetch tool. Skipped with a log entry when the current service has no fetch API
prop.codeact.enable_image_output.hint: When enabled, scripts can put images into the result container (Images.Add) or call AddImageAsync; only explicitly added images are returned. When disabled, adding images fails explicitly
prop.image_generation_tool_set.configura: Leave empty to expose every enabled configuration from the settings panel; select one to expose only that configuration
prop.set_value.target.hint: Where to write the value: SharedState (this generation only) or KVData (persisted)
prop.set_value.key.hint: Key under which the value is stored
prop.set_value.value_type.hint: Type used when storing into SharedState. KVData always stores strings.
prop.post_tool_call.continue_on_error.hi: When enabled, tool exceptions and missing tools are reported back to the model as error text and the round continues; when disabled the whole round fails. Either way the error is written to the debug output.
prop.post_tool_call.max_calls.hint: 0 means unlimited. Dropped calls are recorded in the debug output.
prop.post_tool_call.emit_sender.hint: Sender role used when writing tool results into the conversation
prop.post_tool_call.no_tool_call.hint: Loop behaviour when this round has no tool calls: keep the current directive (default stop) or force another round
prop.append_chat_messages.dangling_tool_: Assistants tool calls must each have a matching tool result, otherwise OpenAI-compatible providers reject the request. InjectPlaceholder adds a prompt-only placeholder result and logs a warning; FailFast aborts generation instead.
prop.append_chat_messages.image_processi: History images are re-sent to the model every round: AsStored sends them exactly as persisted (default); Budgeted scales and re-encodes images above the pixel budget before they enter the request, so oversized images cannot push the chat past the provider payload limit. Only the in-flight request copy is affected — messages and files stay untouched.
prop.append_chat_messages.pixel_budget.h: Per-image width × height ceiling; larger images are scaled down proportionally. 2048×2048 ≈ 4.19M pixels matches the high-resolution limit of mainstream multimodal models.
prop.append_chat_messages.compression.hi: Images above the budget are re-encoded in this format after scaling: scale-only keeps the original format; WebP is smallest and keeps transparency; JPEG is the most compatible (transparency flattened to white).
prop.append_chat_messages.quality.hint: Lossy encoding quality (1-100; higher means sharper but larger).
prop.advanced_fragment.role.hint: Fragment role; tool_result requires a tool_call_id
prop.advanced_fragment.content.hint: Text content; may be empty for image-only messages
prop.advanced_fragment.images_json.hint: Upload images or edit JSON (base64, data URL, or objects with base64 / fileName); tool_result images need the Special Role Image Carrier node
prop.advanced_fragment.tool_call_id.hint: Tool call id this tool_result answers, written to ChatMessage.id
prop.advanced_fragment.tool_calls_json.h: Assistant tool call array; object arguments are serialized to strings
prop.advanced_fragment.thinking.hint: Reasoning content echoed for assistant messages; leave empty to omit
prop.advanced_fragment.custom_properties: Message-level properties merged into the request message object
prop.special_role_image_carrier.system.h: System messages may only contain text under the OpenAI schema; images move into a pseudo-user message placed right after
prop.special_role_image_carrier.tool_res: Append one pseudo-user message after the whole contiguous tool-result run, keeping tool_calls pairing and result continuity intact
prop.special_role_image_carrier.assistan: Insert the pseudo-user message before the assistant message, so tool_calls pairing stays valid
prop.post_loop_directive.directive.hint: Stop, or continue with another round
prop.post_message.mode.hint: Append to the conversation, or replace the response text
prop.post_message.sender.hint: Role used when appending the message
prop.post_condition.ss_key.hint: Key read from the cross-round shared state
prop.post_condition.kv_collection.hint: Collection read when the source is KV storage
prop.post_condition.kv_key.hint: Key read when the source is KV storage
prop.post_condition.operator.hint: Comparison mode; numeric when both sides parse as numbers
prop.post_sub_agent.output_mode.hint: LastMessage, FullJson, or None. Overrides config if set
prop.post_sub_agent.include_full_context: When enabled, passes the full conversation history (PreFragments) along with the LLM response to the sub-agent. When disabled, only the LLM response text is passed.
prop.post_sub_agent.shared_guid.hint: When enabled, the sub-agent inherits the parent AgentGuid. When disabled, uses the config GUID as an independent identity.
prop.auto_chat_name.strategy.hint: NamePattern: only generate when name matches default date format; GuidFlag: generate once per chat; Always: regenerate every time
prop.auto_chat_name.latest_n.hint: Number of recent conversation turns to pass to the LLM
prop.auto_chat_name.prompt_template.hint: Use {conversation} as the placeholder for conversation content
prop.memory_retrieve.top_k.hint: Candidates fetched per query before deduplication.
prop.memory_retrieve.profile.hint: Leave empty to follow the active profile; otherwise this node pins that profile's index.
